Customer food ordering mobile app. Warm editorial minimal style: elegant SERIF display headings (Newsreader, with one italic orange accent phrase), clean geometric sans (DM Sans) for all UI text, big real overhead food photography with soft warm shadows, 20px radius cards, full-round pill chips and pill search bar, round icon category chips, soft diffuse warm-brown shadows, thin rounded line icons. NO emoji, NO illustrations, NO neon, NO purple/blue.
## Dark: warm espresso dark (NOT pure black, NOT blue): background #1B1411, cards/surfaces #2A201B with 1px rgba(255,236,220,0.08) border, ink #F8EDE3, secondary #A8968A. Same orange #F0703A to terracotta #D4572B gradient for CTA, active chip and active nav. Icon circles #3A2A22. Gold #F2A93B stars. No glow.

screens.prompt:
Mobile customer food ordering app "Ember". Screen: CART / CHECKOUT in DARK MODE.
Style & Theme Specifications:
- Palette: Background #1B1411 (warm deep espresso, NOT black, NOT blue/navy), cards/surfaces #2A201B with 1px border rgba(255, 236, 220, 0.08), ink #F8EDE3, secondary #A8968A.
- Accent: Warm orange gradient from #F0703A to #D4572B for CTA button. Icon circles #3A2A22. Gold #F2A93B star, soft green #6FBF7C for 'Free delivery' badge. No neon glow.
- Typography: Display headings in Newsreader serif font with ONE italic orange accent phrase (e.g., My Cart where Cart is italic orange #F0703A). UI text in clean geometric sans (DM Sans).
- Geometry: 20px radius cards, full-round pill chips, clean rounded line icons. NO emojis, NO cartoon illustrations.
- Viewport: Fits clean 390x844 mobile layout with airy padding, high-end editorial minimal feel.

Screen Layout & Content:
- Header: Round back button (left), centered title "My Cart" (with "Cart" in italic orange Newsreader serif), right muted text "Clear".
- Delivery card (#2A201B, rounded-2xl, border rgba(255,236,220,0.08)): Map pin icon in #3A2A22 circular container, "DELIVER TO" in tiny uppercase muted secondary + "Home · 24 Park Lane, Apt 5" in bright ink, right small orange link "Change". Beneath it: soft pill chip with clock icon "Arrives in 25–30 min" and "On time" green indicator pill.
- Section Header: "3 ITEMS" (muted uppercase tracker) with right label "From Ember Kitchen" in delicate italic serif.
- Cart Items List:
  1. Salmon Poke Bowl: photo {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_46}}, note "Extra avocado", bold price "$16.00", subtle circular/pill stepper [- 1 +].
  2. Margherita Pizza: photo {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_31}}, note "Medium, thin crust", bold price "$12.00", stepper [- 1 +].
  3. Iced Matcha Latte: photo {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_30}}, note "Oat milk", bold price "$4.50", stepper [- 1 +].
- Promo row: Dashed border pill container (#2A201B with dashed orange/warm border), tag icon, text "EMBER30 applied" with small note "30% off your artisanal lunch order", right highlighted orange "-$9.75" with a small dismiss icon.
- Delivery instructions / note row: Pill card with courier/door icon: "Leave order at the apartment front door".
- Payment row: Card container (#2A201B) with credit card icon in #3A2A22 circle, "Visa •••• 4242" with "DEFAULT" badge, "Expires 08/28", right chevron arrow.
- Bill / Order Summary Card (#2A201B):
  - "ORDER SUMMARY" header
  - Subtotal: $32.50
  - Delivery fee: Free delivery (in soft green #6FBF7C badge)
  - Promo (EMBER30): -$9.75 (orange)
  - Subtle divider line
  - Total: Bold serif heading "Total", price "$22.75" in Newsreader serif, muted subtext "Includes taxes & fees".
- Sticky Bottom Action Bar:
  - Sticky bottom gradient pill button from #F0703A to #D4572B with lock/bag icon: "Place order · $22.75 →"
  - Microcopy underneath: "By placing this order, you agree to Ember's Terms of Service."
  - NO bottom navigation bar on this screen.
## Available Images
You MUST include the following images in this design. You must reference them
by putting their exact placeholder IDs in `src` attributes or CSS
`background-image` rules. Do NOT use external URLs or generate new
placeholders. Preserve these IDs exactly as written. Read each image's
Description to understand its subject, intended section, and visual role.

- {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_30}}
  Description: Close-up top-down photography of an iced matcha latte in a glass cup with organic oat milk swirls and condensation, minimal aesthetic, warm editorial studio light
  Dimensions: 1024x1024
  Aspect Ratio: 1.00
- {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_31}}
  Description: Close-up overhead food photography of an artisan Margherita pizza with melted fresh mozzarella, basil leaves, and blistered wood-fired crust on warm ceramic plate, warm diffused editorial lighting, high quality
  Dimensions: 1024x1024
  Aspect Ratio: 1.00
- {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_46}}
  Description: Overhead top-down flat-lay food photography of fresh salmon poke bowl with vibrant diced raw salmon sashimi, sliced avocado, edamame beans, diced fresh mango, pickled radishes, and nori on seasoned sushi rice in a beautiful dark ceramic bowl, on an immaculate warm cream surface (#FBF4EC) with soft diffused warm studio lighting and subtle natural shadows, high-end editorial food photography, 8k resolution, minimalist presentation
  Dimensions: 1024x1024

outputComponents.text:
I have crafted the dark-mode **Cart & Checkout** screen for **Ember** (Ember - Cart & Checkout (Dark Mode)), adhering strictly to the warm espresso editorial aesthetic and your exact specifications:

### Key Design Highlights:
- **Palette & Warm Dark Mode**: Built on a rich warm espresso background (`#1B1411`) with surface cards in `#2A201B` framed by delicate `1px rgba(255, 236, 220, 0.08)` borders, bright warm ink (`#F8EDE3`), and muted taupe secondary text (`#A8968A`).
- **Editorial Typography**: Styled with *Newsreader* serif for the centered *"My Cart"* title (with *"Cart"* in italic terracotta orange) and order totals, paired with geometric *DM Sans* for all labels and numbers.
- **Delivery Card**: Displays delivery destination *"Home · 24 Park Lane, Apt 5"* with a rounded map-pin badge and an orange *"Change"* action, plus an *"Arrives in 25–30 min"* status pill with a green *"On time"* pill indicator.
- **Cart Items (3 items)**: Includes real overhead food photography for the **Salmon Poke Bowl** (`$16.00`), **Margherita Pizza** (`$12.00`), and **Iced Matcha Latte** (`$4.50`), each featuring custom modifiers, bold pricing, and tactile minimal steppers `[- 1 +]`.
- **Promo & Payment Details**: A dashed promo card highlighting *"EMBER30 applied"* (`-$9.75`), drop-off instructions, and a saved default Visa card row.
- **Order Summary & Sticky Checkout**: Itemized bill breakdown with free delivery in green (`#6FBF7C`), discount subtraction, prominent `$22.75` total, and a full-width sticky CTA button with the signature orange gradient (`#F0703A` to `#D4572B`). Bottom navigation is excluded as requested.

Theme & Styling: - Strict DARK MODE in warm espresso brown: background #1B1411 (NOT pure black, NOT navy, NOT purple). - Card / bottom sheet surfaces: #2A201B with 1px border rgba(255,236,220,0.08) and 20px / 24px border radius. - Ink / primary text: #F8EDE3. Layout requirements: 1. Top ~40%: - A soft warm peach-cream circular backdrop/halo with a large round overhead photo of the colorful Sesame Tofu grain bowl {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_10}} with soft drop shadow. - Fixed or floating top buttons: round back button at top left and round heart (favorite) button at top right on dark circular surfaces (icon circle #3A2A22 or backdrop blur). 2. Below it, rounded content sheet (bg #2A201B, rounded-t-3xl or rounded-3xl with subtle border border-[rgba(255,236,220,0.08)]): - Small restaurant header row: muted restaurant name "Harvest Bowl Co." and a green #6FBF7C 'Free delivery' badge. - Dish title & price row: serif display title "Sesame Tofu Bowl" with the price "$14.50" in warm orange on the right. - Meta pill row (three small rounded pills): * Star 4.8 (1.2k) with gold star #F2A93B * 15–20 min with clock icon * 540 kcal with flame icon - Two lines of muted secondary description: "Crispy sesame tofu, edamame, soft egg, sweet corn, cucumber and red cabbage with miso-ginger dressing." - Chef or culinary note pill/card (optional subtle touch, dark espresso surface). - Section heading: "Add extras" with "OPTIONAL" tag. - Three customized option rows, each with: * A small round photo thumbnail * Item name and description/serving * Price addition * A round checkbox on the right: 1) "Extra avocado" +$1.50 (CHECKED with orange fill #F0703A and white checkmark) 2) "Edamame" +$1.00 (unchecked circle) 3) "Add salmon" +$3.00 (unchecked circle) - Special instructions text area / input field with subtle placeholder: "Add notes for the kitchen (e.g., dressing on side)..." 3. outputComponents.text:
I have created the dark mode **Dish Detail** screen for **Ember** featuring the Sesame Tofu Bowl:

### Design Details & Execution:
- **Warm Espresso Palette**: Grounded in deep espresso brown (`#1B1411`) for the page background, with elevated card surfaces in `#2A201B` and hairline borders (`rgba(255, 236, 220, 0.08)`).
- **Hero Presentation**: Top 40% features a circular hero composition displaying the overhead photography of the colourful Sesame Tofu grain bowl with soft natural shadows, flanked by circular frosted back and favorite actions.
- **Editorial Typography**: Elegant serif display heading (*Newsreader*) featuring the signature italic warm orange accent phrase (*"Sesame Tofu Bowl"*), paired with clean geometric sans (*DM Sans*) for clear utility and price readability (`$14.50`).
- **Metadata & Details**: Includes the `"Harvest Bowl Co."` provenance with an emerald `"Free delivery"` pill badge, followed by quick-glance chips for rating (4.8 with gold star), prep time (15–20 min), and calories (540 kcal), plus an artisanal chef's touch note.
- **Customizable Extras**: Option rows with circular food previews, clear price deltas, and state indicators — including pre-selected `"Extra avocado" (+$1.50)` with active orange fill, alongside `"Edamame"` and `"Add salmon"`.
- **Checkout Action Bar**: Fixed bottom bar featuring a tactile quantity stepper pill and the primary warm orange gradient CTA (*"Add to cart · $16.00"*) calculated with the active add-on. Tab bar intentionally omitted for focused ordering.
